questions.question: When does the next cohort start?
questions.answer: The {{cohort.next}} cohort starts {{cohort.starts}}. It opens to the waitlist first.
questions.answerWhenOpen: The {{cohort.next}} cohort starts {{cohort.starts}}. Enrolment is open, and applications close on {{cohort.applyBy}} or earlier if places fill.

questions.question: Do I need a technical background?
questions.answer: No. Most people come from research, banking, operations or customer-facing roles, and week 1 always. starts from the foundations of the role.

questions.question: Can I join from outside Nigeria?
questions.answer: Yes, from anywhere in Nigeria or abroad. Live sessions run 8 to 10pm West Africa Time: 7 to 9pm in London and Dublin in winter, 11pm in Dubai, 2 to 4pm in New York and Toronto, and early morning in Sydney and Auckland. The table of session times shows your city. Both sessions are recorded.

questions.question: How much time does it take each week?
questions.answer: Two live sessions a week ({{cohort.schedule}}), both recorded, plus time on your weekly deliverable and a pod session your group arranges.

questions.question: How much does it cost?
questions.answer: The {{cohort.next}} fee goes to the waitlist first, before public enrolment. The {{cohort.previous}} cohort was {{cohort.previousFee}}, paid in full when you enrolled. We don't offer instalments at the moment. {{cohort.abroadFee}}
questions.answerWhenOpen: The fee is {{cohort.fee}}, paid in full when you enrol, by card, bank transfer or USSD through Squad. We don't offer instalments at the moment. {{cohort.abroadFee}}

questions.question: When is my place confirmed?
questions.answer: Joining the waitlist does not reserve a place. When enrolment opens, we will explain how to enrol and confirm a place.
questions.answerWhenOpen: Submit the enrolment form first; Squad's secure checkout then opens. Squad confirms your payment to us directly, and we check it against your enrolment and email your joining details.

questions.question: What if I miss a live session?
questions.answer: Every session is recorded, so you can catch up and still submit that week's assignment.

questions.question: Will this get me certified?
questions.answer: The cohort covers the BABOK foundations and ends with an ECBA roadmap. When you finish, you receive a BA Bridge Cohort certificate of completion. Professional certification exams, such as the ECBA, are taken separately through IIBA.

questions.question: Will I get a job at the end?
questions.answer: We don't promise jobs. You finish with real case work to show, a rewritten CV and a mock interview behind you.

questions.question: Can I defer to a later cohort?
questions.answer: Not once training has begun. Before the cohort starts, you can move your place once to the next cohort at no cost.

questions.question: What is the refund policy?
questions.answer: If you withdraw before the cohort begins, you can request a refund less a 10% administrative fee, or move your place once to the next cohort at no cost. Once training has begun, fees are non-refundable and non-transferable. If Practeva postpones or cancels the cohort, you can choose a full refund with no deduction or a place in the next cohort. Send refund requests in writing to {{email}}; we process them within 14 working days.

questions.question: Can you train my team instead?
questions.answer: Yes. Team training is run separately from the cohort, for organisations. Tell us about your team through the contact form.
